qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: ~78% gross margins and ~28% EBIT margins sustained across cycles via RESILIA tissue durability premium pricing, decade-long PARTNER clinical trial moats, and interventional cardiologist switching costs. Primary threat is Medtronic/Boston Scientific competition in mature TAVR and hospital DRG reimbursement pressure.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global category king in transcatheter heart valve therapies with >60% global TAVR share and pioneer status in tricuspid/mitral transcatheter replacement (EVOQUE, PASCAL). Divestiture of Critical Care to BDX for $4.2B cash sharpened pure-play focus on structural heart. Insulated from macro disruptions with massive demographic aging tailwind. Pristine balance sheet with $2.3B+ net cash and 62x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: TAVR procedure volume 5.5% + TMTT portfolio expansion 2.5% + RESILIA pricing/mix 0.5% - clinical trial R&D drag 0.5% + share buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 19.8% and tangible operating ROIC of 27.1%. FY2025 net sales reached $6.07B (+11.5% YoY) with gross margins sustained at 78-79%. Cash conversion normalized post-divestiture with FY2025 Owner FCF of $1.28B converting at 119% of GAAP net income ($1.07B). Net cash of $2.34B ($2.94B cash vs. $598M debt) with 62x interest coverage ($1,264M EBIT / $20.4M interest). TAVR retains ~75% US and >60% global market share supported by PARTNER 1-3 and EARLY TAVR trials; TMTT segment grew >40% in 2024-2025 propelled by FDA approval of Evoque and Pascal Precision.
